info.name: Stack Exchange Access Tokens Posts API

params.name: site
params.description: Target Q&A community. Either the api_site_parameter from a `/sites` entry (e.g. `stackoverflow`, `serverfault`, `superuser`) or a full domain (`stackoverflow.com`).

params.name: key
params.description: App key from stackapps.com. Raises the daily quota to 10,000/IP.

params.name: filter
params.description: Custom response filter id created via /filters/create.

params.name: page
params.description: 1-indexed page number.

params.name: pagesize
params.description: Items per page (max 100).

items.docs: All posts (questions and answers) on a site.
